about_short_description.short_description: CRYO Holdings is a wellness, recovery, and cryotherapy company.

product.name: Whole Body Cryotherapy
product.description: A treatment exposing the entire body to extremely cold air at temperatures as low as -140°C for up to three minutes to stimulate blood circulation and metabolic activity.

product.name: Localized Cryotherapy
product.description: A targeted cold therapy applied to specific body areas to reduce pain, inflammation, and improve skin and wellness conditions.

product.name: °CRYO Facial Treatments
product.description: Facial therapies using cryotherapy and related technologies to improve skin condition, reduce wrinkles, and enhance skin texture.

product.name: Compression Therapy
product.description: A treatment using controlled pressure to improve circulation, reduce swelling, and aid muscle recovery.

product.name: Red Light Therapy
product.description: A treatment using red and near-infrared light to stimulate cellular function, promote healing, and improve skin health.

product.name: Infrared Sauna
product.description: A sauna treatment using infrared light to heat the body directly, promoting relaxation, detoxification, and circulation.
